learning: Confirmed: the iteration 4 drop came from the kp 1.0 and row change together, and kp 1.2 is the working gain for the ±0.03 m row. Still open: whether ±0.04 m at kp 1.2 helps, and whether 16 mm footprint noise adds s-bend oscillation (0.168). Line loss at start-up versus at the coverage edge is not yet separated.
notes: Confirmation package: the best-raced geometry with the controller that produced 69.46 in iterations 3, 5, 6 and 7. It holds the controller at its best-supported values so the Builder's revert is judged on the platform it was tuned for.
rationale: The best raced design is the ±0.03 m row at 16 mm with y = 0.04, kp 1.2, kd 0.4 and base_speed 1.1. It scored 69.46 in iterations 3, 5, 6 and 7, so the simulator is deterministic for this package. The Builder has reverted the geometry to that row, and I hold the controller unchanged so this race confirms the best-supported package. Every run still ends off track near max error 0.062 m, against the 0.06 m limit, and line loss stays at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run. Iteration 4 changed kp to 1.0 and widened the row together, and that is the only race that drops below 69, so I keep kp at 1.2. The steering weights (-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) are unchanged and ki stays at 0 to avoid windup. Expected result: about 69.46, with no new best. I make no other claim about this package.
